implementation.rationale: The existing request-bound adapter checks address/blockType/toAddress/data and an opaque caller-supplied subjectDigest. This slice derives that digest from a declared populated UserSend subject, links the exact selected x402 upfront requirement/resource, and checks the original quoted Momentum acknowledgement before policy use.
implementation.abstractPreparation: The prior abstract ZenonTransactionPlanner class, assertion and NOT_IMPLEMENTED behavior are preserved byte-for-byte. This is an implemented pricing/binding stage, not an implemented prepareUnsigned() or a prepared block.

subjectDigest.encoding: sha256: plus SHA256 of the existing canonicalJson encoding of [domain, detached exact subject].

paymentBinding: Reuse the existing canonical positive255-bit amount validator, selected active-upfront requirement snapshot, same-requirement comparison and paymentIntentDigest; no SDK is imported.

Clone the selected challenge as bounded descriptor-safe JSON DATA before invoking the existing wire validator/canonicalizer. Require a single selected offer, HTTPS resource and the existing descriptive zenon:testnet lane.
Require independently supplied payerAddress equal subject.address; require subject recipient, amount, asset and chain identifier match the selected requirement.
Require the subject's exact canonical32-byte Base64 data equal the existing x402 payment-intent digest covering the resource and complete selected requirement.
Build the existing expected request/profile/compiled-ID context from that bound subject and selected requirement, then use the unchanged raw-schema3 required-fused adapter.
Bind the subject acknowledgement height/hash to the ORIGINAL quoted Momentum, not a later current-price observation.

Recompute the subject and intent on apply/validate; check a distinct wrapper receipt, then delegate the original pair, p, price/resource/window and current-observation checks to the existing shared adapter/validator.

receipt.innerSourceQuote: Unchanged request-bound required-fused policy receipt version2.

implementation.compatibility: The older quote/apply context contracts and old shared adapter remain selected through their existing methods. New wrapper receipts are not accepted as old receipts, and old receipts do not satisfy the new methods. No default or active buyer path is rewired.
limitations: This binds declared populated subject DATA. It is not evidence that these are the fields a real SDK/preparer or signer will consume.

The subject projection excludes fusedPlasma, difficulty, nonce, hash, publicKey and signature. Plasma selection is checked separately by the shared policy; work/nonce, block hash, public-key binding and signature validity remain unqualified.
The token field is a bounded printable-ASCII identifier compared exactly with the selected asset. Token checksum, token existence and chain validity are not established.
A populated account height/previous hash and an acknowledgement are not authenticated account/frontier state or ancestry. Matching profile and compiled IDs are not chain/runtime authentication.
UNSIGNED is supplied metadata, not signer-state or consumed-authority proof. Coherent alternative caller DATA and receipts can be constructed; hashes/freezing do not establish custody or authority.

The runtimeContextDigest remains caller-declared. Actual deployed runtime p/governance stability, source/binary/genesis/spork identity and real quote/preparation/work/signing/inclusion price behavior remain separate gates.
The existing generic x402 payment-intent canonicalization is reused, not standardized as official x402 conformance or as a public Zenon block-hash encoding.
No native HTTPS owner enforcement, active buyer/SDK cutover, provider readiness, real funding/payment, restart recovery, durable custody or commit/uncertainty qualification is added.

qualification.changedGraphReason: The existing strategy now imports the pure planner binding, wire validation and canonicalization graph. The42 existing authored scenario bodies are retained and requalified against this changed graph rather than counted from earlier runs.
qualification.keyObservedDifferential: At a later declared Momentum101, the existing raw adapter accepted a coherent receipt carrying the unchanged subject digest and selected fusedPlasma26670/difficulty0. The new UserSend path rejected that same inner receipt because the subject acknowledgement remained at original Momentum100. The original correctly bound receipt still applied across admitted current-price advances.
qualification.subjectOracle: A separately authored fixed-key canonical preimage and SHA256 was compared with the helper's exact subject digest. Account height/previous-hash changes changed the derived subject digest while the RPC request context stayed identical.
qualification.dataClass: Synthetic in-memory declared subjects, selected requirements/resources and raw endpoint observations. The changed-graph collector case still uses two in-memory frozen read transports. No real RPC/socket/server/SDK/provider is involved.
qualification.abstractMethodExercise: One call to the unchanged abstract prepareUnsigned() was required to refuse as NOT_IMPLEMENTED; no actual SDK prepareBlock/prepareUnsigned implementation or chain preparation ran.
